objects.taxonomy_description: Small Old World monkey measuring 30-60 cm body length weighing 2-8 kg. Body covered with long hair around face forming distinctive facial ruff. Fur coloration variable by species in gray, brown, olive, or red. Face bare with expressive features. Eyes forward-facing with brown irises. Nose narrow. Ears small. Tail long and non-prehensile. Hind limbs elongated. Body slender and agile. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, fur insulation, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. African arboreal monkey with complex social behavior.

objects.taxonomy_description: Handheld collapsible canopy mounted on a central shaft with radiating ribs. Canopy is fabric (nylon, polyester) stretched over 6-8 metal or fiberglass ribs. When open, diameter is 90-120 cm. Shaft is metal or wood with a curved or straight handle. Collapsible models fold down to 25-35 cm via a telescoping shaft and folding ribs. Canopy colors range from solid black to vibrant patterns. Tip of each rib has a small protective cap. Opening mechanism is manual (push-up) or automatic (button-activated). Ribs converge at a runner that slides along the shaft.
